gateContractTests.scope: Validator evidence-binding tests, separate from pack scientific tests.

staticValidation.name: Prodigal prokaryotic genes
staticValidation.description: Predict coding genes, proteins and coding DNA in prokaryotic genomes or metagenomic contigs. Native optional pack; no external runtime.

staticValidation.name: FastTree phylogenetics
staticValidation.description: Serial approximate maximum-likelihood trees from nucleotide/protein alignments, with explicit models and local support.

checks: prodigal: exact ZIP native import, declared scientific checks and duplicate-version rejection.
fasttree: exact ZIP native import, declared scientific checks and duplicate-version rejection.
prodigal: exact-pin normal graph execution, incompatible input/stale pin rejection, methods/CWL and searchable results.
fasttree: exact-pin normal graph execution, incompatible input/stale pin rejection, methods/CWL and searchable results.
The native library discovers both installed 1.0.0 packs and displays both Prodigal and both FastTree operations under their actual catalogue labels.
Native pointer selection opens prodigal/predict-genome with exact pack version, declared input/option labels and reachable form pages.
Native pointer selection opens prodigal/predict-metagenome with exact pack version, declared input/option labels and reachable form pages.
Native pointer selection opens fasttree/infer-nucleotide with exact pack version, declared input/option labels and reachable form pages.
Native pointer selection opens fasttree/infer-protein with exact pack version, declared input/option labels and reachable form pages.
Native Results search finds Pack candidate prodigal and displays its successful native operation, exact pack/executable versions and recorded manifest identity without a QC verdict.
Native Results search finds Pack candidate fasttree and displays its successful native operation, exact pack/executable versions and recorded manifest identity without a QC verdict.
Pinned application and installed pack bytes remain unchanged after execution.
